budgetMeaning: All bindings share one durable claims directory. Numeric limits and absolute deadline are admission/turn-boundary thresholds, not hard in-flight billing or force-kill limits. In-flight work uses existing per-arm/turn timeout and owned cleanup.
stopPolicy: Any execution failure, cap, raw accounting/capture incomplete, source/config/session/memory drift or unsafe cleanup stops affected binding; all known costs preserved. Quality false with normal fully accounted arm continues.

statistics.unit: Independent matched pair of continuous 12-turn sessions, not turn
statistics.primary: Per binding and task: sum(current usage)/sum(native usage) over its two fixed pairs; per binding overall: sums across all four pairs. Incomplete planned cohort yields primary null; preserve known all-cost ledger.
outputs: optional cache/reasoning only when fully provided
statistics.limits: Descriptive replicated two-workload study; no currency, equivalence or default-product efficiency claim.
statistics.quality: Machine artifact/fact acceptance reported separately without excluding failed arms; narrative semantics require separately labelled review.

treatmentScope: current=shared native-final trial on actual Loom daemon/Role path; NOT deployed seven-flags-off product default; no private prompt candidate
memory: Native automatic memory disabled every initial/resume, verifiable in captured invocation/config; normal session history and native compaction/retry preserved
requiresBeforeStart: Explicit owner approval of this exact batch
Record owner approval, frozen method and exact model/effort combinations
Fill current absolute expiresAt and exact common/binding releases; recheck closure before launch
limitations: Five CLI bindings across four model families, not multiple models per CLI
Kimi actual print/ACP dynamic tool-schema difference remains; end-to-end path comparison only
Two pairs per task are descriptive, not equivalence or universal stability proof
Current arm is isolated native-final trial, not production with seven flags off
Input/output/request counts are separately reported quantities, not invoices; Codex request field is telemetry events
